AnalysisFaceOut.description: One detected face, as exposed in the analysis status (catalog.analysis_status).
AnalysisFaceOut.title: AnalysisFaceOut

AnalysisObjectOut.description: One detected object in a semantic analysis (analysis.py DetectedObject).
AnalysisObjectOut.title: AnalysisObjectOut

AnalysisRequest.description: Select explicit assets or the complete active library for AI analysis.
AnalysisRequest.title: AnalysisRequest

AnalysisResultOut.description:
The stored public analysis result (analysis_runs.result jsonb).

This is exactly what the AI worker writes: the semantic document fields
plus ``faceCount`` and ``personCount``.
AnalysisResultOut.title: AnalysisResultOut

AnalysisStatusOut.description: AI analysis job + latest run for one asset (catalog.analysis_status).

analyzedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the current run.
analyzedAt.title: Analyzedat

artifactKey.description: S3 key of the full analysis artifact.
artifactKey.title: Artifactkey

AnalysisStatusOut.title: AnalysisStatusOut

AssetDetailV1Out.description: GET /assets/{id} for a v1 document: the document plus derived blocks.
AssetDetailV1Out.title: AssetDetailV1Out

AssetDetailV2Out.description:
GET /assets/{id} for a v2 document: the document plus derived blocks.

``userState`` is inherited from the document variant; the endpoint
overwrites it with the same (column-synced) values.
AssetDetailV2Out.title: AssetDetailV2Out

AssetDocV1Out.description:
A v1 manifest document: exactly the 11 keys the v1 writer emits.

v1 documents have ``revision`` fixed at 1, ``previousRevision`` null, and
no ``userState``/``deletedAt``/``mutation`` keys at all.
AssetDocV1Out.title: AssetDocV1Out

AssetDocV2Out.description: A v2 manifest document: v1 fields plus user state and mutation ancestry.
AssetDocV2Out.title: AssetDocV2Out

BlobOut.description: One blob reference inside a manifest document (models.py Blob).
BlobOut.title: BlobOut

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when exhausted.
nextCursor.title: Nextcursor

BurstDetailOut.description: A burst cluster and its frames (catalog.burst_detail).
BurstDetailOut.title: BurstDetailOut

LocationOut.description: A location tag: a name plus an optional lat/long pair (models.py Location).
LocationOut.title: LocationOut

MutationOut.description: The last mutation applied to a v2 manifest document (models.py Mutation).
MutationOut.title: MutationOut

PhotoSummaryOut.description: One browse row (browsing.asset_summary): the compact card data.
PhotoSummaryOut.title: PhotoSummaryOut

PreviewStatusOut.description: Derivative (preview/thumbnail) job state for one asset (catalog.preview_status).
PreviewStatusOut.title: PreviewStatusOut

ProcessingRequest.description: Select processing stages and either explicit assets or the active library.
ProcessingRequest.title: ProcessingRequest

ProcessingStatusOut.description:
One reprocessing stage job (catalog.processing_status entries).

``job_type`` is the one snake_case key in an otherwise camelCase API:
the catalog copies the database row mapping verbatim, and the goldens
pin it, so the alias overrides the camelCase generator.
ProcessingStatusOut.title: ProcessingStatusOut

UserStateOut.description: User-edited state for one asset (models.py UserState).
UserStateOut.title: UserStateOut
